Ansel must also restore eastern Steward before any lethal subsequent shell.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Eastern Steward owns artillery damage and Ansel owns his treatment. Durin overlaps the lower eastern artillery segment. Require artillery death without leak.
Plume clears the eastern upper roadblock; Midnight clears the western upper roadblock and intercepts threatening officers. Require protected arrival.
Opening Melantha clears the eastern lower roadblock; Gallus clears the western lower roadblock. Lower-outer blockers intercept nearby officers. Require protected arrival.
Fang hands to Beagle. Durin then redeployed Steward supplies upper-central arts under both medics. Maintain interception through actual deaths of both upper armors and runners.
Vanilla hands to Spot. Lava supplies persistent lower-central arts under both medics. Kill #20, #22, and armored #34 while preserving block capacity.
Plume, Midnight, returning Melantha, and Noir Corne provide successive upper-outer interception.
Opening Melantha, Popukar, Friston, and Cardigan provide successive lower-outer interception; Gallus supports after roadblock clearance.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward remains until 4650. Durin enters at 4590 with coverage of [2,7], [2,6], and [2,5], overlapping the final eastern artillery opportunity. Artillery death and surviving pending shell impacts must be observed.
formation_structure.capacity: Maximum eight deployed rarity-2/3 operators. Current runtime exempts rarity-1 operators from that counter. Durin and Lava enter before eastern Steward withdraws, briefly filling all eight counted slots.
formation_structure.central: Beagle replaces Fang at 2880 after the fourth grant. Spot remains lower-central. Durin RIGHT covers Beagle and upstream upper-central cells; Lava LEFT covers Spot and its approach. Neither caster depends on splash damage.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP; natural 1 DP/s; Fang grants at 570,1320,2070,2820; Vanilla activations at 750,1650.
economy.checked_balances: Declared minimum DP is 0. Durin deployment leaves 42 DP and Lava deployment leaves approximately 12.333 DP, both before Steward's retreat refund. Final Steward deployment leaves 51 DP.
economy.conditional_retreat_refunds: Melantha 7, Vanilla 5, Plume 5, Lancet 1, Fang 5, Popukar 9, first Steward 9, Midnight 8, Friston 1, second Melantha 7, Durin 6.
economy.redeployment: Melantha's first withdrawal to return exceeds 70 seconds. Steward's 4650-to-6780 interval is 2130 frames, exceeding the current-model 2100-frame cooldown.
economy.survival_dependency: Grants require living owners and refunds require successful living retreats. A missing grant or successor is a survival/handoff failure; no death refund or unsupported income is credited.

formation_structure.medical: Hibiscus DOWN [5,5] and Ansel UP [2,6] cover each other in ordinary range. Both also cover Beagle [3,5], Spot [4,5], Durin or redeployed Steward [2,5], and Lava [5,6]. Only Ansel covers eastern Steward [5,7]. Coverage does not guarantee recipient selection.
formation_structure.opening_survival: Keep the four opening interceptions. Hibiscus redirects healing toward the central line rather than opening Melantha. The archived opening Melantha damage total was 2270 before withdrawal, below her listed 2745 HP; this remains conditional on unchanged hostile contact.
formation_structure.outer: Midnight enters at 3180 before modeled outer officer contact. Gallus independently clears the western lower roadblock. Popukar, Friston, and Cardigan share lower-outer interception; Midnight, returning Melantha, and Noir Corne share upper-outer interception.

Replace Vanilla with Spot on the same lower-central tile.

Replace Popukar with Friston on the same lower-outer tile.

Install persistent lower-central Lava before armored contact.

Transfer upper-outer interception from Midnight to returning Melantha.
Replace Friston with Cardigan before the final lower-outer officer queue develops.
Install Noir Corne upstream of Melantha's former tile for the final upper-outer officer.
Replace Durin with redeployed Steward on the same upper-central arts tile.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true; exclude mode-specific reserve units.
Every deployment uses legal integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on the forbidden set.
Execute the listed frames in order, including retreat before deployment at shared frames. Phase conditions and diagnostic criteria introduce no conditional actions.
Both medics must remain alive and actually heal intended patients before lethal hits. Reciprocal geometry alone does not discharge this duty; pending fixed-point shells survive retreat.
Observe artillery death without leak during the eastern damage window. Hit totals, emitted commands, and hypothetical target priority are insufficient.
Beagle and Spot retain interception under both medics and sustained arts. Require actual deaths without leaks for #20/#21/#22 and armored #34; track blocked counts against capacity three.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Destroy all four restraints and intercept officers before protected deaths; do not count medic healing on civilians.
Credit only successful grants and living retreat refunds. Maintain successor occupancy, redeployment cooldowns, affordability, and the current-model deployment cap.
Credit Lava only with current generic single-target arts. Exclude unsupported splash, dodge, probability talents, summons, healing modes, self-heals, robot buffs, resistance reduction, and kill DP.
remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths, and all 2 expected protected targets safely reached. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Intercept opening runners, destroy eastern roadblocks, establish reciprocal medicine, and preserve living income owners.
Replace Fang early, sustain both medics through artillery exposure, intercept outer officers, and progress western roadblock destruction.
Kill the artillery, resolve pending shells, establish both central arts positions, and maintain #20/#21/#22 interception through healing and damage.
Complete both protected arrivals, execute outer replacements, clear earlier armor before queues saturate, and intercept final runners and armor.
Maintain both central arts positions and medical cycles until every hostile dies, with zero leaks and both protected objectives confirmed.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income through the fourth grant only; no later grant credited.
Support lower shell exposure, reciprocal medicine, and sustained central pressure.
First boost spans the dangerous upper artillery window; later boosts cover armored contact and prolonged clearance. Principal recipients are already in ordinary range.
Accelerate the first lower-outer officer pair.
Reduce physical pressure during mixed waves; no mitigation of enemy arts is credited.
Finish upper-outer officers and western upper roadblock clearance using supported arts conversion.
Accelerate single-target lower-central arts against the first armor and final queue. First activation uses deployment SP; subsequent gaps include active duration and full recharge.
Use ordinary arts and Steward's supported automatic attack-SP skill. Do not assume talent target priority or resistance reduction.
Use ordinary listed combat stats only; no healing modes, self-heals, mitigation talents, or passive stat bonuses credited.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: R8-7-M48-V1 replaces isolated medical coverage with reciprocal healing and replaces Fang before the dangerous eastern artillery window. Steward retains eastern artillery responsibility, with overlapping Durin coverage before withdrawal. Durin and Lava establish sustained arts on both central blockers before armored contact. Preserve independent roadblock clearance and outer interception duties, while requiring actual hostile deaths and both protected arrivals. This is an unexecuted current-model hypothesis.

revised_stage_understanding.current_model: Use the supplied quantized spawn schedule, ordinary combat and healing rules, fixed-point delayed artillery impacts, and runtime deployment/refund semantics.
revised_stage_understanding.feedback_provenance: Prior static feedback reports NO_SIMULATION and no conflicts. Causal battle evidence belongs to archived R8_7_GPT_M47_V2; its event frames are conditional observations.
revised_stage_understanding.source_backed_facts: Civilians are neutral, ordinary operators neither attack nor block them, roadblocks specially restrain them, safe arrival has no life cost, and death costs one life. Officers can attack civilians within 1.2.
unknowns: Exact client timing and build-2771 equivalence.
Client target ordering and medical equal-ratio ties.
Active roadblock effects on ordinary WALK navigation.
Unsupported talents, splash geometry, and special effects.

changed_premises: Mutual medical coverage replaces the failed isolated-recipient arrangement.
Earlier defender replacement reduces healing competition during repeated upper shells.
Persistent lower arts is funded before the artillery operator's refund.
Western artillery detours are replaced by eastern overlap and permanent central clearance.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Reciprocal medicine and earlier Beagle deployment preserve Ansel, Hibiscus, and eastern Steward long enough to kill the artillery. Sustained arts on both central blockers then closes mixed-pressure and final-armor failures while independent western restraint clearance preserves both protected arrivals.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Require current-model WIN plus zero leaks, zero protected-target deaths, and all 2 expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives.
revised_tactical_requirements.artillery: Observe artillery death without leak; account for target contention and already-created shells.
revised_tactical_requirements.interception: Maintain living blockers, legal successors, affordability, healing, and damage through actual deaths of #20/#21/#22 and armored #34.
revised_tactical_requirements.medical: Demonstrate reciprocal healing before lethal impacts and treatment of eastern Steward; geometric coverage alone is insufficient.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Independently destroy all four restraints and contain nearby officers; ordinary medics are not credited with healing civilians.
revised_tactical_requirements.static_resolution: The supplied prior conflict list is empty. The new declared timeline independently passes read-only legality, range, DP, SP-gap, capacity, and cooldown checks; no tactical actions were selected or altered by Python.

Beagle replaces Fang at 2880 after four grants; Midnight deploys later while retaining upper-outer interception and western clearance.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the proposed medical-allocation premise and inspect actual shell and heal recipients before interpreting later failures. This interval is a conditional diagnostic prediction based on the retained early artillery geometry, not a universal deadline or an executable rescue condition.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Hibiscus facing DOWN, Ansel's retimed boost, and Beagle replacing Fang before the upper shell sequence will preserve medical and artillery continuity. Overlapping eastern arts and persistent central casters will convert that survival into artillery and armored deaths while retaining independent civilian-release duties.
